load_configuration: load a Hydra configuration from a config name with command-line overrides and run mode
load_sweep_config: load a sweep configuration by recreating the master config with additional sweep overrides
compute_defaults_list: compute the defaults list for a given config name, overrides, and run mode
get_group_options: get available options for a config group with optional overrides and result filtering
apply_overrides_to_config: apply a list of parsed overrides to an OmegaConf DictConfig with add, delete, and force-add support
get_overrides_dirname: generate a sorted override directory name string from a list of overrides with custom separators
validate_sweep_overrides_legal: validate that sweep overrides are legal for the given run mode and shell context
list_groups: list all config group names under a given parent group name
get_sources: get the list of all ConfigSource objects from the config repository
